universities.name: Inha University
universities.ranking: #13 in South Korea, Top 300 QS World
universities.acceptanceRate: High for qualified Nepali STEM & Business applicants
features: Subway line direct connection to central Seoul (40 mins)
Dedicated Global Center with Nepali student community
Automatic 50% entrance scholarship for IELTS 6.5+ or TOPIK 4
High placement in Samsung, LG, Hyundai tech ecosystems

universities.name: SolBridge International School of Business (Woosong Univ)
universities.acceptanceRate: Very high for motivated English speakers
features: 100% English curriculum with American-style professors
Dual degree exchange opportunities in USA, Europe & Australia
Generous scholarship renewal each semester with GPA 3.0+
Located in Daejeon (Korea's Silicon Valley)

universities.name: Sejong University
universities.ranking: Top 10 in Korea, #1 in Hospitality & Tourism
universities.acceptanceRate: Competitive with strong visa track record
features: Prime central Seoul campus right next to Children's Grand Park subway
Renowned hospitality program with paid 5-star hotel internships
High visa approval rate for GBS applicants
Active international student exchange clubs

universities.name: Chung-Ang University (CAU)
features: Scenic campus overlooking the Han River in Seoul
Special first-semester 50% tuition reduction for admitted international students
Robust career counseling & Korean employment sponsorship (E-7 visa conversion)
Top-tier research facilities

universities.name: Kyungpook National University (KNU)
universities.ranking: Top Flagship National University in South Korea
features: Government National University — 50% lower base tuition than private colleges
Very low cost of living in Daegu (~50% cheaper than Seoul)
Abundant part-time work in Daegu industrial & commercial zones
Full GKS Korean Government Scholarship host institution

universities.name: Pusan National University (PNU)
universities.acceptanceRate: High prestige with great employment outcome in Busan port & tech hub
features: Located in South Korea's vibrant coastal metropolis Busan
Massive on-campus modern dormitories and sports complexes
High part-time job opportunities in tourism, logistics, and tech
Strong research grants for Master's/PhD candidates

universities.name: Hanyang University (ERICA & Seoul)
universities.ranking: Top 3 Engineering powerhouse in Korea, QS #157
features: Direct campus subway station inside the university
Industry-integrated campus (ERICA cluster with research giants)
High salary graduate outcomes in Korean conglomerates
Generous HISP scholarship for high IELTS/SAT/GPA scorers

universities.name: Keimyung University (KMU)
popularMajors: Keimyung Adams College (100% English Business & International Studies)
features: Keimyung Adams College offers 100% English degrees with no Korean required
Affordable dormitory accommodation with meal plans included
Direct GBS institutional support & fast Certificate of Admission (CoA)
Filming location of famous K-dramas (Boys Over Flowers, Extra-ordinary You)
